description: This file contains PHP functions and schema definitions for managing database structure, including creation of tables and schema definitions for a web application, likely an e-commerce platform based on the table names and context.

methods.name: oc_db_create
methods.description: Creates database tables based on predefined schema, drops existing tables if they exist, and returns true on success.

methods.name: oc_db_schema
methods.description: Returns an array representing the structure and definitions of database tables.
